verdict.rationale: Google Drive documents its own REST API (v3) covering file listing, uploads including resumable large-file transfers, bulk modification, permissions, custom properties, and push notifications, so its core operations can be driven without the UI. However, the evidence only mentions OAuth scopes configured in the Cloud console and shows no non-interactive credential path, official CLI, or CI-specific guidance; rclone is a third-party tool and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive auth (e.g. service accounts) for CI, an official CLI or CI integration guide, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
